A community of creative and critical thinkers
Natural sciences are crucial to solving global challenges. We’re committed to research-led teaching and fostering a passion for lifelong learning in our graduates.
We teach, discover and collaborate across the broad realm of the natural sciences. Our goal is to provide our students, researchers and partners the best opportunities to tackle the challenges the natural world faces.
Renowned worldwide for their work and research
Worldwide academic, industry and research partnerships
Environmental, Biological & Agricultural Sciences: ERA 2018
Focused on achieving excellence
We consistently achieve the highest ratings in Excellence in Research for Australia (ERA) institution reports and are ranked number one in Sydney for science graduates’ median salary for the 2018 and 2019 Student Experience Survey.
